description:
Thermalright M1 Thermal Paste – High Performance CPU & GPU Thermal Compound

Product description

The Thermalright M1 Thermal Paste is a high-performance thermal interface material designed to efficiently transfer heat from CPUs, GPUs, and other heat-generating components to their cooling solutions. With a 12.9 W/m·K thermal conductivity, M1 helps improve heat transfer between the chip and heatsink or cooler, supporting effective thermal management during gaming, demanding workloads, and everyday PC operation. It is available in 2.5g, 4.5g, 6.5g, and 8.5g quantities, allowing users to select the amount suited to their build or repasting requirements.

Thermalright M1 is electrically non-conductive, making it safer to use around electronic components because the thermal compound does not conduct electricity. Its high thermal conductivity and non-conductive formulation make it suitable for CPU and GPU cooling applications where reliable heat transfer is required. The available 2.5g, 4.5g, 6.5g, and 8.5g options also provide flexibility for individual repasting or multiple applications.

  • Dual Haptic Trackpads

  • Brand New (Box Pack)
description:
Valve Steam Controller in Pakistan

Product Description

The Valve Steam Controller is designed to bring the flexibility of PC gaming controls into a traditional gamepad-style design. It works with Steam Input, allowing players to customize controls for different games and create configurations that match their preferred play style. It is particularly useful for games that traditionally rely on keyboard and mouse controls.

Key Features

The controller features two full-size magnetic TMR thumbsticks with capacitive touch, two 34.5 mm haptic trackpads, A/B/X/Y buttons, a D-pad, analog triggers, bumpers, Steam and Quick Access Menu buttons, and four assignable grip buttons on the back. These inputs give players more control options while keeping commonly used commands within easy reach.

Its haptic feedback system uses four haptic motors, including dedicated motors in the trackpads and grips, providing detailed tactile feedback during gameplay. The controller also includes a 6-axis IMU gyro and capacitive grip sensing, allowing motion-based aiming and other customized controls.

Connectivity & Wireless Performance

The Steam Controller supports wireless connectivity through the Steam Controller Puck, which uses a 2.4 GHz wireless connection. Valve specifies approximately 8 ms full end-to-end latency and 4 ms polling at 5 m. It also supports Bluetooth 4.2 or newer and USB-C wired play, giving users multiple connection options.

What Does the Controller Package Include?

The Steam Controller setup includes the Steam Controller Puck, which acts as the wireless transmitter and also provides a magnetic charging interface. The controller has a USB-C connection and an internal 8.39 Wh Li-ion battery, with Valve rating it for 35+ hours of gameplay under specified conditions

Who Is It Best For?

The Steam Controller is best suited for PC gamers who primarily use Steam, especially players who want gamepad comfort while playing titles designed around keyboard-and-mouse controls. The customizable trackpads, gyro controls and assignable rear buttons make it particularly useful for FPS, strategy, simulation, RPG and other PC-focused games where conventional controllers may offer limited control options.

Why Buy the Valve Steam Controller?

For PC gamers, the biggest advantage is customization. Steam Input allows controls to be configured on a per-game basis, while the trackpads and gyro can provide more precise input than a conventional gamepad in certain genres. The ergonomic layout, wireless connectivity, haptic feedback and multiple programmable inputs make it a strong choice for gamers who want a more flexible way to play their Steam library.
